verdict.rationale: Token2's own tools let users delete data stored on their keys: the fido2-manage CLI/GUI can delete resident credentials (passkeys) and biometric templates, and the Companion App can perform factory resets. The TOTP toolset states that computation is local and no seed is sent to a server, which limits server-side retention. However, nothing documents retention policies or controls over data Token2 itself may hold. missing for 10: documented vendor-side retention policy or retention settings, deletion of any account or cloud data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Resident credentials (passkeys): list (with user handle), delete, edit metadata
Biometric templates (bio models): list, rename, delete, enroll
manage passkeys, change PINs, and perform factory resets
All computation happens locally — no seed is ever sent to a server.
